**Finding: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or pricing-parity obligation running against us. Targeted searches ("favorable/favourable", "most favored nation", "best", "lowest", "parity", "discount", "match", "terms offered") returned nothing relevant, and the commercial provisions I reviewed are fixed-rate or revenue-share terms rather than parity undertakings:

- **Article V fees (p0056–p0067):** tiered per-US$1m volume bands — fixed rates only.
- **Supplemental Payments (p0078–p0083):** a 33% share of specified third-party earnings — a revenue split, not an obligation to give Licensor terms no less favourable than third parties receive.
- **Support/fees (p0086–p0089):** capped charges, with no additional fees absent written agreement.
- **p0094:** the only "other licensees" reference obliges Licensor to release Revisions to us when generally available — this runs in our favour and is left untouched.

This matches the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer). An MFN in our favour would be a nice-to-have rather than a demand, so no edit is warranted.
